grade.description: Per-world color grade (hue/saturation/brightness/contrast), promoted from the frontend's per-theme table in schemaVersion 1.2. Deliberately NOT required — configs stored before 1.2 have no grade key and renderers fall back to the built-in theme grade table.

belt.description: Procedural asteroid belt parameters (presence, density, distance, rock color, plane tilt). Added in schemaVersion 1.2; deliberately NOT required — configs stored before 1.2 have no belt key and renderers fall back to built-in defaults.

comets.description: Seeded comet population (count 0-3 and tail length multiplier). Added in schemaVersion 1.2; deliberately NOT required — configs stored before 1.2 have no comets key and renderers fall back to a single comet with a neutral tail.

sun.description: Central star temperature class (surface tint, glow and light colors) plus HDR surface intensity. Added in schemaVersion 1.2; deliberately NOT required — configs stored before 1.2 have no sun key and renderers fall back to the built-in warm-yellow star.

sky.description: Night-sky rendering parameters (Milky Way band + constellation figures). Added in schemaVersion 1.1; deliberately NOT required — configs stored before 1.1 have no sky key and renderers fall back to built-in defaults.
